name: American River (South Fork / Coloma–Lotus)
gaugeName: South Fork American River near Placerville

gaugeContext.note: The listed USGS station is upstream near Chili Bar. Dam releases can change conditions downstream; the station is a reference and does not provide a reviewed travel-speed model. Check the river and release information before launching.
gaugeContext.sourceName: USGS — South Fork American River near Placerville

timing.note: No reviewed flow-to-speed calibration or endpoint-specific published travel time is available. Access and approximate distance remain useful when the gauge has no current reading.

blurb: A four-mile South Fork American whitewater option from Lotus to Greenwood, with Class II–II+ rapids and a carry-out before the downstream Gorge. Check dam releases and scout the takeout.

sections.notes: Set the shuttle before launching. Henningsen Lotus Park is at 950 Lotus Road; confirm current vehicle and river-use fees and closing hours. Greenwood has a carry to the Highway 49 parking area and limited parking. Identify the takeout before your trip; continuing downstream leads toward the more difficult Gorge.

distanceEvidence.note: Approximate distance between named river access areas, derived from rounded county river-mile markers. The Greenwood landing and carry are not surveyed; do not use this as exact shoreline-to-shoreline mileage.

notices.title: Whitewater and changing releases
notices.text: This reach includes Barking Dog, Current Divider and Highway Rapid, with Class II–II+ water. It is not a calm tubing shortcut. Scout unfamiliar features and confirm release conditions.

notices.title: Greenwood takeout and carry
notices.text: BLM identifies Greenwood as the takeout for the Coloma-to-Greenwood run. The marker locates the parking area; check the shoreline exit and carry trail before launching. The downstream run includes Class III whitewater.

putInAccess.sourceName: California State Parks DBW — Henningsen-Lotus BTAF; El Dorado County
putInAccess.note: State facility coordinate matches the public river beach at the north end of the park boat-loading area in satellite imagery reviewed 2026-11-03. The county documents a boat launch at 950 Lotus Road. This is a checked access location, not a survey of the water edge; changing flow affects the landing. Set a shuttle and check park hours and fees.

takeOutAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management — Mother Lode Field Office
takeOutAccess.note: BLM confirms this as the Coloma-to-Greenwood takeout and a lower-run launch. Its published coordinate marks the parking area, not the exact shoreline takeout. Retain the sourced area position and invite a reviewed landing suggestion. Day use only; commercial and organized activities have separate permit requirements.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed Greenwood Creek access on Highway 49, just south of Magnolia Ranch. Carry boats on the access trail; overflow parking at Magnolia is linked by a trail. Check the landing and carry before launching.

mapAuditNote: Henningsen Lotus landing matches state facility coordinate and imagery; Greenwood remains a sourced approximate facility. River-course review is independent.
